gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight runs compact, with ascenders that barely clear the lowercase. Beneath Conthrax, with its wide, geometric display letters, that compact line works like a quiet counterweight, one voice stretched out and one pulled in.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-karla: Conthrax is all wide-mouthed geometry, its lowercase nearly as large as its capitals. Karla meets it with a gaping c and a stocky middle band, friendlier and more compact on the line.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-khula: Machined and wide: Conthrax keeps both edges of every curve running parallel. And Khula, with its squat, brush-pen belly and curves that hold their mouths open, feels hand-warmed beside it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-krub: Poured-ink geometry, wide and uniform: that is Conthrax at a glance. Krub feels looser beside it: a generous x-height, open pen-lifted curves, and a sigh of relief after all that precision.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-kufam: Conthrax draws wide, geometric letters that read like following one continuous thread. Kufam, with its neon-tube strokes and generously open e, would carry a page of text with a smooth, steady glow.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-lexend-deca: Conthrax is wide, geometric and built to stand out. Lexend Deca does the opposite job, keeping its line plain and unshaded, with terminals that stop short, so the text simply gets read.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-liter: Liter reads with no stroke contrast at all, its lowercase carrying real vertical presence and its round forms opening wide. And Conthrax, wide and geometric above it, gives that clarity a sleek, machined headline to lean on.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-mada: Mada keeps its curves open, never quite closing them. Conthrax does its best work in wide, geometric display shapes with joins as sturdy as the stems, while Mada handles running text.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-matangi: Conthrax opens wide and geometric, its lowercase a spreading a generous mouth. But Matangi pushes back on the page with twine-like strokes, rounded letters left open and a hefty lowercase body.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-michroma: Conthrax draws wide, geometric letters whose thickness never shifts with direction. And Michroma gives every letter a wide berth and keeps its ascenders stubby, which lends the pair spacious, uniform clarity.
